exampleSentence: You must obtain permission before entering the laboratory.
exampleTranslation: 进入实验室前，你必须获得许可。

exampleSentence: She was obviously tired after the long journey.
exampleTranslation: 长途旅行后，她显然累了。

exampleSentence: The wedding was a happy occasion for the whole family.
exampleTranslation: 这场婚礼是全家人欢聚的喜庆场合。

exampleSentence: We occasionally meet for coffee after work.
exampleTranslation: 我们偶尔在下班后一起喝咖啡。

exampleSentence: Teaching is a demanding occupation that requires patience.
exampleTranslation: 教书是一份需要耐心的辛苦职业。

exampleSentence: Books and papers occupy most of the space on his desk.
exampleTranslation: 书和文件占据了他书桌的大部分空间。

exampleSentence: Accidents can occur when drivers ignore the rules.
exampleTranslation: 司机无视规则时，事故可能发生。

exampleSentence: Power cuts are a common occurrence in the village.
exampleTranslation: 停电在这个村庄是常有的事。

exampleSentence: The ocean covers more than half of the planet's surface.
exampleTranslation: 海洋覆盖了地球表面的一半以上。

exampleSentence: Oceania includes Australia and many Pacific island nations.
exampleTranslation: 大洋洲包括澳大利亚和许多太平洋岛国。

exampleSentence: A strange odor came from the kitchen.
exampleTranslation: 厨房里传来一股奇怪的气味。

exampleSentence: The room had a faint odour of fresh paint.
exampleTranslation: 房间里有淡淡的油漆气味。

exampleSentence: He apologized for any offence his remark had caused.
exampleTranslation: 他为自己的话可能造成的冒犯道了歉。

exampleSentence: I did not mean to offend anyone with my comment.
exampleTranslation: 我无意用自己的评论冒犯任何人。

exampleSentence: She apologized for the offense her words had caused.
exampleTranslation: 她为自己的话造成的冒犯道了歉。

exampleSentence: They offer free advice to new customers.
exampleTranslation: 他们向新顾客提供免费咨询。

exampleSentence: Her office is on the third floor of the building.
exampleTranslation: 她的办公室在这栋楼的三层。

exampleSentence: A police officer directed traffic at the crossing.
exampleTranslation: 一名警官在十字路口指挥交通。

exampleSentence: The official report will be published next week.
exampleTranslation: 官方报告将于下周发布。

exampleSentence: Planting trees can offset some of the carbon emissions.
exampleTranslation: 植树可以抵消一部分碳排放。

exampleSentence: The pair raised three offspring in the safety of the forest.
exampleTranslation: 这对动物在安全的森林里养育了三只后代。

exampleSentence: She often walks to work when the weather is fine.
exampleTranslation: 天气好的时候，她经常步行上班。

exampleSentence: A resistance of one ohm allows one ampere to flow when one volt is applied.
exampleTranslation: 施加一伏电压时，一欧姆的电阻允许一安培的电流通过。

exampleSentence: The engine needs oil to run smoothly.
exampleTranslation: 发动机需要机油才能平稳运转。

exampleSentence: The old man walked slowly along the beach.
exampleTranslation: 那位老人沿着海滩慢慢走着。
